title: Choir and Salt Revisited
author: Yara Sterling
blurb: Silas Brightwater, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
